title: John Chowning - Stria (1977)
summary: John Chowning's 1977 computer music piece Stria, composed with FM synthesis, which he discovered in 1967. It unifies timbre and scale structure around the Golden Mean.
why: HN cites it as an example of early academic FM synthesis composition and the Golden Mean in music.

quote.text: work Stria ( ) unifies timbre and scale structure about the Golden Mean as a musical interval.
